records.eventLabel: cue sports at the 2022 World Games
records.text: On July 13, 2022, cue sports at the 2022 World Games began at Birmingham–Jefferson Convention Complex.
records.textJa: 2022年7月13日、cue sports at the 2022 World Gamesが始まった（Birmingham–Jefferson Convention Complex）。

records.eventLabel: cue sports at the 2022 World Games
records.text: On July 17, 2022, cue sports at the 2022 World Games ended at Birmingham–Jefferson Convention Complex.
records.textJa: 2022年7月17日、cue sports at the 2022 World Gamesが終わった（Birmingham–Jefferson Convention Complex）。
